review_scope: Exact final source/protocol of one fixed A/B saved-numeric translated-query diagnostic; no numeric-body decoding, pair preparation, renderer or model execution.

mathematical_review.reference: Every required depth is positive and finite. z_i=solve(Q0.R,X_i-C)_z and m0=median(z_i) use the unshifted archived raw query, before either intervention.
mathematical_review.B_rule: lambda_i=m0/z_i; Xprime_i=C+lambda_i*(X_i-C); radiusprime_i=lambda_i*radius_i. Positive lambda makes historical homogeneous projection cancel when centers are exactly shared.
mathematical_review.compatibility: Five historical centers and original query center must be exactly equal after float64 representation. Actual stored-K projections of all 515 points are checked per camera at 1e-10 native coordinates. No claim of complete-image, clipping or occlusion equivalence.
mathematical_review.query: One delta=0.1*m0*Q0.R[:,0]. Both target arrays share float64 promotion and the same delta; original average/axis conversion define a common query. Every actual hook checks exact rawpose/focal/kwargs equality, and A/B raw-query fingerprints must agree. Promoted-vs-original rotation difference is recorded rather than presumed zero.
mathematical_review.units: The unchanged S61 adapter may produce separate unit receipts, but both receive the same raw physical query. Rescaling geometry and query translation inside each adapter does not define a second query.

checks: Author five-file set is readonly and all hashes match; S63 parent and 15 inherited/provenance source-or-metadata hashes checked. Earlier author check is retained separately from final check.

Nine S63 helpers and six constants are extracted from exact original AST nodes; original main/run_arm and golden reference execution are excluded. Existing loader retains 1496 unique numeric blobs / 1631256 bytes, including already-seen empty-map arrays without using them as new-arm oracle.

Original FP32 query reconstruction, exact shared centers, finite positive depths and all historical point projections are checked before either renderer. B reference-depth flattening has explicit relative-error check. No subset selection, fallback or parameter search.

A retains original surfel data; B only changes declared positions/radii. Normal/source/cache fingerprints remain equal. Original input, branch scratch and actual kernel-attached geometry/cache/target/mapping are fingerprint-checked before/after; mutation raises immediately.

Independent A/B kernel instances each call unchanged get_context_info/default None NMS and real cache gathering. Each valid arm requires exactly one original renderer and one original retrieval call. All four context fields are checked per selected slot against actual FP32 cache bytes.

Participating members are derived from index>=0 and cosine>=0, including cos=0, and match original sorted weights. Finite weights and all-one quotas for the fixed <=5-source pool are required. IDs are not predetermined; valid smaller candidate pools can yield fewer than four IDs.

Actual query fingerprints and historical NMS thresholds must match between valid arms. Full member sets, quotas and ordered IDs are compared. Different IDs mean sensitivity only; same IDs with effective point-projection change reject only this fixed selected-ID explanation.

Fresh execution_01, A then B once, 110-second stage/final checks and external <=120-second supervision. Incompatible input prevents both arms; ordinary arm failure is retained and the independent other branch can still run. Input mutation stops immediately. NPZ/JSON/readlist/receipt and partial artifacts are retained and readonly at normal exit.
